question: Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi and Prime Minister of Bhutan Lotay Tshering virtually launched _______ to allow Bhutanese cardholders to access RuPay network in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**RuPay card Phase II.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM Narendra Modi and Bhutanese PM Lotay** Tshering jointly launched** RuPay card Phase II on November 20, 2020**, which will allow Bhutan citizens to access the RuPay network in India.
 
• Phase I was launched in August** 2019**.
 
• RuPay cards issued by the Bhutan National Bank can be used at ATMs for** Rs 1 lakh and for Rs 20 lakh at point-of-sale terminals**.
 
• RuPay is an Indian multinational financial services and payment service system, conceived and launched by the National Payments Corporation of India on 26 March 2012.
 
• RuPay cards accepted Country names, **Singapore (2018), Bhutan (2020), UAE (2019), Bahrain,Saudi Arabia.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bhutan**.

 
 
• Capital: **Thimphu**.
 
• Official language:** Dzongkha.**
 
• Prime Minister: **Lotay Tshering**.
 
• Currency: **Bhutanese Ngultrum. **
 
 

**​As of September(2022).**
